name: below the nucleus: a baryon on a chain
plain: Computed in this page by this repository's engine (holon-render's sub-atom band): the EXACT colour-singlet ground state of one-flavour QCD in ONE space dimension, 4 sites, x = 4, 64 determinants. Columns: each site's quark density summed over colours; grey ghost, the sea's 1.5; warm cap, the baryon's excess, three quarks in all. Tubes: the computed colour-electric energy on each link (the Casimir of the colour charge to its left; 0.40, 0.91, 0.40 at rest), the one-dimensional flux tube. IT MOVES because one site is pulled (gold well, depth 1) and the state runs under exp(-iHt) exactly: the outer links swing most (0.24 to 0.49), at the pulled chain's first energy gap, 3.48, every 3 s here; the middle one at the gaps near 7.3 and 9.2. NOT the proton and NOT the 3+1D vacuum of lattice QCD: no transverse gluons, Gauss's law fixes the field, the tube's width is drawn and not computed, the chain's length is SET to the proton's diameter (the ring) by choice, and it is four sites because six take a second to solve.
